room_rent.note: Default is At Actuals for Optima Secure, Optima Super Secure, Optima Suraksha, Global plans, and Optima Secure+. Optima Select defaults to Single Private Room; Optima Lite defaults to 1% of BSI/day. Optional room rent modification available for some plans.

icu.note: At Actuals for most plans. Optima Lite has 2% of BSI/day cap. Proportionate deduction does not apply to associated medical expenses during ICU stay.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment. No tier-based co-payment either — insured from lower tier can avail treatment in higher tier without co-pay.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise sub-limits specified in the policy wording. All covers are up to Sum Insured unless a specific optional aggregate deductible is chosen.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional aggregate deductible ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹25L can be opted at inception/renewal to reduce premium.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents. Waived after 12 months of continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Default PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional PED wait period modification (channel-level only, not available to individual customers directly).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder, kidney stones, varicose veins, etc. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity is excluded under standard exclusion Excl18. Available as 'Parenthood' add-on covering maternity expenses, embryo freezing and IVF with 2-year waiting period.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB of 10% per year up to 100% of BSI available in Optima Suraksha plan. Not available in Optima Secure, Optima Super Secure, Global plans, or Optima Secure+. Optima Select has 25%/yr up to 100%. CB ceases if Plus Benefit is opted.

restoration.note: Automatic Restore Benefit triggers once per year (100% of BSI) for Optima Secure, Optima Super Secure, Optima Suraksha, Global plans. Optima Select, Optima Lite, and Optima Secure+ have unlimited restorations inbuilt. Restored SI can be used for same or different illness.

pre_hosp.note: 60 days for all plans except Optima Lite (30 days). Optima Lite's 30-day limit is inbuilt.

post_hosp.note: 180 days for all plans except Optima Lite (60 days). Optima Lite's 60-day limit is inbuilt.

day_care.note: All day care treatments covered up to Sum Insured across all plans.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered up to Sum Insured. Home Health Care also covered (pre-authorization required, cashless only).

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to Sum Insured in all plans.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered up to Sum Insured. Pre/post-hospitalisation and transport of organ excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured for emergency transfer or hospital-to-home (same city). Emergency Air Ambulance up to ₹5L as optional/inbuilt cover depending on plan.

modern_treatments.note: No specific exclusion or sub-limit for modern/robotic treatments; covered under hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses covered via 'Protect Benefit' optional cover (inbuilt in some plans like Optima Secure by default, optional in others). Standard non-medical items listed in Annexure B are excluded unless Protect Benefit is active.

global_cover.note: Global Health Cover (Emergency only) and Global Health Cover (Emergency & Planned) available as optional covers. Inbuilt in Optima Secure Global and Optima Secure Global Plus plans.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage available during grace period for instalment payers.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity (std excl), congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, sleep apnoea investigation, circumcision, alopecia, external prosthetics/devices, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness add-on, Hospital Cash add-on, Personal Accident rider, Unlimited Restore add-on, Optima Wellbeing (OPD), ABCD Chronic Care, Limitless, Parenthood (maternity/IVF)
